data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 6 has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works

If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 6 go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone 6.

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The most common issues faced by the users that are reported in the iPhone 6 users community forum are as follows:

  • Too sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto touch)
  • Touchscreen in your iPhone does not respond at all
  • Ghost Touch / Delayed Touch issue
  • Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to work fine)


There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. Those are the following listed below:

  • Make sure your touch screen protector doesn’t interfere with proper operation.
  • Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass)
  • Disconnect your USB-lightning port to check if it works. 
  • If your phone is above normal temperature wait for it to cool down and then try again.
  • Restart your device.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues regarding touch on your iPhone 6. ifixit bd is located in 4 different service points.
